description: Paste text with Cmd+V through the clipboard, then put the user's clipboard back: every item and type is copied aside and restored within one call, only after the paste shows in the focused element (else after a 1 s hold) and only if nothing else wrote to the clipboard meanwhile; a password manager's concealed item is never copied — the clipboard is cleared after the paste instead. The pasted text is marked transient for clipboard managers. Pass app to refuse input unless that app is frontmost (focus guard). Refused when the clipboard holds Universal Clipboard content or more than 64 MB (force:true pastes anyway and leaves the pasted text on the clipboard). mac_type does not touch the clipboard.
name: mac_paste
